title: Tortuga 1301
meta_description: Tortuga 1301: Beachfront corner condo with sweeping Gulf views, balcony, resort amenities, and space for groups of 10.
description_expanded:
Welcome to Tortuga 1301, a bright and breezy beachfront condo where sweeping Gulf views set the tone for effortless days on the water. Perched high above Panama City Beach's sugar-white shoreline, West facing corner unit places you within minutes of local favorites like Pier Park, Top Golf, ParkDolly Parton's Pirates Voyage, Shipwreck Island Waterpark, and a long stretch of walkable beachfront restaurants---ideal for families, couples, and groups craving convenience paired with incredible ocean scenery.

Inside, an open-concept layout brings everyone together with wall-to-wall windows, a spacious living area, and a private balcony made for sunrise coffees and sunset toasts. The full kitchen offers plenty of room to prep meals, while the large dining table for eight ensures everyone has a seat. A laptop-friendly workspace makes it easy to blend work and wanderlust.

With three ensuite bedrooms plus a double-over-double bunkroom, the home comfortably sleeps ten. Each bedroom feels calm and coastal, offering a restful retreat after a day in the sun. The in-unit washer and dryer keep beach days simple, and beach gear, including toys and a small surfboard, are ready for guests to enjoy.

Your stay includes access to a wide range of resort-style amenities: indoor and outdoor pools, a full gym, a lively game room, an on-site café, and direct beach access just steps from the building. Whether you're planning long, lazy beach days or exploring the best of PCB, Tortuga 1301 blends comfort, convenience, and the kind of views you'll remember long after your stay.

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

Panama City Beach is one of Florida's most welcoming coastal destinations, known for its 27 miles of sugar-white sand, emerald Gulf waters, and a vibrant mix of family-friendly attractions, waterfront dining, and outdoor adventure. Guests can spend their days exploring St. Andrews State Park, spotting dolphins on Shell Island excursions, savoring fresh seafood at local institutions like Schooners, or enjoying the lively entertainment and shopping at Pier Park. With its easygoing atmosphere, year-round sunshine, and endless blend of relaxation and recreation, PCB offers something for every type of traveler---from beach lovers and boaters to families, foodies, and groups looking to unwind by the water.

Local Attractions: Pier Park, Dolly Pirate Ship, Top Golf, Shipwreck Island Waterpark, Russell-Fields Pier, St. Andrews State Park, Thomas Drive, Shell Island, Conservation Park, WonderWorks, Ripley's Believe It or Not, Camp Helen State Park, Frank Brown Park, Panama City Beach Winery, Aaron Bessant Park, Laguna Beach.

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval there is a fine of $500 per pet.
- The elevators are not controlled by the management company but by the on site HOA management and we are not responsible for any repairs or delays although we try our best to communicate them up front. If in the event there are issues experienced, we do not provide compensation or refunds due to those issues.
- Please note your home comes equipped with a high-chair a pack'and'play.
- Please note that the building is currently undergoing an elevator replacement project involving all 7 elevators. While elevators remain operational, guests may experience longer wait times, especially during peak hours.

Parking Details:
- Parking Pass Required: A one-time fee per stay is due at the time of check-in. Wristbands will be given to guests age 12 and up at check-in. Guests are required to wear the wristbands while on the property.
- Parking for 2 cars max.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

BTR#: 71066
